**pGene and pSNP Linear Regression**
```{r}
#tensorQTL
data <- data.frame(
  population = c("AFR", "CHN", "EUR", "HIS", "ALL"),
  pop_size = c(675, 366, 1270, 642, 2953),
  cis_count = c(795, 568, 1008, 705, 1279),
  trans_count = c(673, 954, 653, 781, 586)
)

#pSNP
data2 <- data.frame(
  population = c("AFR", "CHN", "EUR", "HIS", "ALL"),
  pop_size = c(675, 366, 1270, 642, 2953),
  cis_count = c(208536, 136757, 433556, 243137, 514717),
  trans_count = c(16673, 50226, 33117, 32819, 42543)
)

#linear regression: cis gene count vs population size
cis_model <- lm(cis_count ~ pop_size, data = data2)
cis_summary <- summary(cis_model)

#linear regression: trans gene count vs population size  
trans_model <- lm(trans_count ~ pop_size, data = data2)
trans_summary <- summary(trans_model)

#results
cat("CIS GENES vs POPULATION SIZE:\n")
cat("Slope:", cis_model$coefficients[2], "\n")
cat("R-squared:", cis_summary$r.squared, "\n")
cat("P-value:", cis_summary$coefficients[2,4], "\n\n")

cat("TRANS GENES vs POPULATION SIZE:\n")
cat("Slope:", trans_model$coefficients[2], "\n") 
cat("R-squared:", trans_summary$r.squared, "\n")
cat("P-value:", trans_summary$coefficients[2,4], "\n")
```

**Credible Sets per Protein**
```{r}
#load data
cis_all  <- fread("~/tensor_susie/all_race/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", header = TRUE)
cis_euro <- fread("~/tensor_susie/euro_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", header = TRUE)
cis_afr  <- fread("~/tensor_susie/afr_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", header = TRUE)
cis_hisp <- fread("~/tensor_susie/hisp_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", header = TRUE)
cis_chn  <- fread("~/tensor_susie/chn_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", header = TRUE)

trans_all  <- fread("~/tensor_susie/all_race/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", header = TRUE)
trans_euro <- fread("~/tensor_susie/euro_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", header = TRUE)
trans_afr  <- fread("~/tensor_susie/afr_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", header = TRUE)
trans_hisp <- fread("~/tensor_susie/hisp_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", header = TRUE)
trans_chn  <- fread("~/tensor_susie/chn_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", header = TRUE)

#data processing
process_data <- function(data, pop_name) {
  data %>%
    distinct(gene_id, cs_label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    summarise(cs_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(population = pop_name)
}

cis_combined <- rbind(
  process_data(cis_all,  "ALL"),
  process_data(cis_euro, "EUR"),
  process_data(cis_afr,  "AFR"),
  process_data(cis_hisp, "HIS"),
  process_data(cis_chn,  "CHN")
)

trans_combined <- rbind(
  process_data(trans_all,  "ALL"),
  process_data(trans_euro, "EUR"),
  process_data(trans_afr,  "AFR"),
  process_data(trans_hisp, "HIS"),
  process_data(trans_chn,  "CHN")
)

#set population as factor
pop_order <- c("ALL", "EUR", "AFR", "HIS", "CHN")
cis_combined$population   <- factor(cis_combined$population,   levels = pop_order)
trans_combined$population <- factor(trans_combined$population, levels = pop_order)

#counts
sample_sizes <- data.frame(
  population = c("ALL", "EUR", "AFR", "HIS", "CHN"),
  pop_size   = c(2953, 1270, 675, 642, 366)
)

#total CS counts per population
cis_totals <- cis_combined %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(total_cs = sum(cs_count), .groups = "drop")
trans_totals <- trans_combined %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(total_cs = sum(cs_count), .groups = "drop")
cis_cor_data   <- left_join(sample_sizes, cis_totals,   by = "population")
trans_cor_data <- left_join(sample_sizes, trans_totals, by = "population")
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2), round(p, 4))
}

#statistics
desc_cis <- cis_combined %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(
    N_proteins     = n(),
    Mean_CS        = round(mean(cs_count), 2),
    Median_CS      = round(median(cs_count), 1),
    SD_CS          = round(sd(cs_count), 2),
    Total_CS       = sum(cs_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

desc_trans <- trans_combined %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(
    N_proteins     = n(),
    Mean_CS        = round(mean(cs_count), 2),
    Median_CS      = round(median(cs_count), 1),
    SD_CS          = round(sd(cs_count), 2),
    Total_CS       = sum(cs_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(as.data.frame(desc_cis), row.names = FALSE)
print(as.data.frame(desc_trans), row.names = FALSE)

#kruskal wallis
kw_cis   <- kruskal.test(cs_count ~ population, data = cis_combined)
kw_trans <- kruskal.test(cs_count ~ population, data = trans_combined)

overall_table <- data.frame(
  QTL_type  = c("Cis", "Trans"),
  Test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  Statistic = round(c(kw_cis$statistic, kw_trans$statistic), 3),
  df        = c(kw_cis$parameter, kw_trans$parameter),
  P_value   = fmt_p(c(kw_cis$p.value, kw_trans$p.value)),
  Significant = c(kw_cis$p.value < 0.05, kw_trans$p.value < 0.05)
)

print(overall_table, row.names = FALSE)

#dunns post-hoc test
dunn_cis   <- dunnTest(cs_count ~ population, data = cis_combined,   method = "bonferroni")$res
dunn_trans <- dunnTest(cs_count ~ population, data = trans_combined, method = "bonferroni")$res
format_dunn <- function(d, qtl_label) {
  d %>%
    transmute(
      QTL_type   = qtl_label,
      Comparison = Comparison,
      Z          = round(Z, 3),
      P_unadj    = fmt_p(P.unadj),
      P_adj_Bonf = fmt_p(P.adj),
      Significant = P.adj < 0.05
    )
}
pairwise_table <- rbind(
  format_dunn(dunn_cis,   "Cis"),
  format_dunn(dunn_trans, "Trans")
)
print(as.data.frame(pairwise_table), row.names = FALSE)
```

**Credible Set Size by Ancestry**
```{r}
#load data
load_data <- function(file_path, data_type, ancestry) {
  tryCatch({
    data <- fread(file_path, header = TRUE)
    data$data_type <- data_type
    data$ancestry  <- ancestry
    return(data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error loading file:", file_path, "\nError:", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

trans_all  <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/all_race/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv",  "trans", "ALL")
trans_euro <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/euro_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", "trans", "EUR")
trans_afr  <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/afr_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv",  "trans", "AFR")
trans_hisp <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/hisp_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv", "trans", "HIS")
trans_chn  <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/chn_amer/0.05trans_finemap_edited.tsv",  "trans", "CHN")

cis_all  <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/all_race/0.05cis_finemap.tsv",  "cis", "ALL")
cis_euro <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/euro_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", "cis", "EUR")
cis_afr  <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/afr_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv",  "cis", "AFR")
cis_hisp <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/hisp_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv", "cis", "HIS")
cis_chn  <- load_data("~/tensor_susie/chn_amer/0.05cis_finemap.tsv",  "cis", "CHN")

all_data <- rbindlist(list(
  trans_all, trans_euro, trans_afr, trans_hisp, trans_chn,
  cis_all, cis_euro, cis_afr, cis_hisp, cis_chn
), fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)

all_data$af <- NULL

#build per-CS summary
cs_size_data <- all_data %>%
  group_by(ancestry, data_type, gene_id, cs_label) %>%
  summarise(
    cs_size = n(),
    max_pip = max(pip, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_pip = mean(pip, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ancestry_order <- c("ALL", "EUR", "AFR", "HIS", "CHN")
cs_size_data$ancestry <- factor(cs_size_data$ancestry, levels = ancestry_order)

cis_cs   <- cs_size_data %>% filter(data_type == "cis")
trans_cs <- cs_size_data %>% filter(data_type == "trans")

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2), round(p, 4))
}

#statistics
desc <- cs_size_data %>%
  group_by(data_type, ancestry) %>%
  summarise(
    N_credible_sets = n(),
    Mean_CS_size    = round(mean(cs_size),   2),
    Median_CS_size  = round(median(cs_size), 1),
    SD_CS_size      = round(sd(cs_size),     2),
    Mean_max_PIP    = round(mean(max_pip),   3),
    Median_max_PIP  = round(median(max_pip), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(as.data.frame(desc), row.names = FALSE)

#Kruskal-Wallis tests
kw_cis_size   <- kruskal.test(cs_size ~ ancestry, data = cis_cs)
kw_trans_size <- kruskal.test(cs_size ~ ancestry, data = trans_cs)

overall <- data.frame(
  QTL_type  = c("Cis", "Trans"),
  Outcome   = c("CS Size", "CS Size"),
  Test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  Statistic = round(c(kw_cis_size$statistic,
                      kw_trans_size$statistic), 3),
  df        = c(kw_cis_size$parameter,
                kw_trans_size$parameter),
  P_value   = fmt_p(c(kw_cis_size$p.value,
                      kw_trans_size$p.value)),
  Significant = c(kw_cis_size$p.value < 0.05,
                  kw_trans_size$p.value < 0.05)
)
print(overall, row.names = FALSE)

#dunns post-hoc test
cis_cs$ancestry   <- as.character(cis_cs$ancestry)
trans_cs$ancestry <- as.character(trans_cs$ancestry)

dunn_cis_size   <- dunnTest(cs_size ~ ancestry, data = cis_cs,   method = "bonferroni")$res
dunn_trans_size <- dunnTest(cs_size ~ ancestry, data = trans_cs, method = "bonferroni")$res

format_dunn <- function(d, qtl, outcome) {
  d %>%
    transmute(
      QTL_type   = qtl,
      Outcome    = outcome,
      Comparison = Comparison,
      Z          = round(Z, 3),
      P_unadj    = fmt_p(P.unadj),
      Significant = P.adj < 0.05
    )
}
pairwise <- rbind(
  format_dunn(dunn_cis_size,   "Cis",   "CS Size"),
  format_dunn(dunn_trans_size, "Trans", "CS Size")
)
print(as.data.frame(pairwise), row.names = FALSE)
```

**Probable Causal SNP Counts by Ancestry**
```{r}
#load data
all_cis  <- fread("~/compare_susie/all_race/0.05cis_R_vs_tensor",  header = TRUE)
euro_cis <- fread("~/compare_susie/euro_amer/0.05cis_R_vs_tensor", header = TRUE)
afr_cis  <- fread("~/compare_susie/afr_amer/0.05cis_R_vs_tensor",  header = TRUE)
chn_cis  <- fread("~/compare_susie/chn_amer/0.05cis_R_vs_tensor",  header = TRUE)
hisp_cis <- fread("~/compare_susie/hisp_amer/0.05cis_R_vs_tensor", header = TRUE)

all_trans  <- fread("~/compare_susie/all_race/0.05trans_R_vs_tensor",  header = TRUE)
euro_trans <- fread("~/compare_susie/euro_amer/0.05trans_R_vs_tensor", header = TRUE)
afr_trans  <- fread("~/compare_susie/afr_amer/0.05trans_R_vs_tensor",  header = TRUE)
chn_trans  <- fread("~/compare_susie/chn_amer/0.05trans_R_vs_tensor",  header = TRUE)
hisp_trans <- fread("~/compare_susie/hisp_amer/0.05trans_R_vs_tensor", header = TRUE)

#extract tensorqtl columns
all_tensor_cis  <- all_cis  %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
euro_tensor_cis <- euro_cis %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
afr_tensor_cis  <- afr_cis  %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
chn_tensor_cis  <- chn_cis  %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
hisp_tensor_cis <- hisp_cis %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
all_tensor_trans  <- all_trans  %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
euro_tensor_trans <- euro_trans %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
afr_tensor_trans  <- afr_trans  %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
chn_tensor_trans  <- chn_trans  %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)
hisp_tensor_trans <- hisp_trans %>% select(phenotype_id, SNP, tensor_CS, tensor_PIP)

#filter for PIP ≥ .9
filter_causal <- function(data, pop_name) {
  data %>%
    filter(tensor_PIP >= 0.9, !is.na(tensor_PIP)) %>%
    group_by(phenotype_id, SNP) %>%
    summarise(
      tensor_CS  = max(tensor_CS,  na.rm = TRUE),
      tensor_PIP = max(tensor_PIP, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    distinct(phenotype_id, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(population = pop_name)
}

all_tensor_cis_causal  <- filter_causal(all_tensor_cis,  "All Ancestries")
euro_tensor_cis_causal <- filter_causal(euro_tensor_cis, "European")
afr_tensor_cis_causal  <- filter_causal(afr_tensor_cis,  "African")
chn_tensor_cis_causal  <- filter_causal(chn_tensor_cis,  "Chinese")
hisp_tensor_cis_causal <- filter_causal(hisp_tensor_cis, "Hispanic")
all_tensor_trans_causal  <- filter_causal(all_tensor_trans,  "All Ancestries")
euro_tensor_trans_causal <- filter_causal(euro_tensor_trans, "European")
afr_tensor_trans_causal  <- filter_causal(afr_tensor_trans,  "African")
chn_tensor_trans_causal  <- filter_causal(chn_tensor_trans,  "Chinese")
hisp_tensor_trans_causal <- filter_causal(hisp_tensor_trans, "Hispanic")

#combine and count
combined_data_cis <- rbind(
  all_tensor_cis_causal  %>% select(population),
  euro_tensor_cis_causal %>% select(population),
  afr_tensor_cis_causal  %>% select(population),
  chn_tensor_cis_causal  %>% select(population),
  hisp_tensor_cis_causal %>% select(population)
)

combined_data_trans <- rbind(
  all_tensor_trans_causal  %>% select(population),
  euro_tensor_trans_causal %>% select(population),
  afr_tensor_trans_causal  %>% select(population),
  chn_tensor_trans_causal  %>% select(population),
  hisp_tensor_trans_causal %>% select(population)
)

count_data_cis <- combined_data_cis %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
count_data_trans <- combined_data_trans %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

pop_order <- c("All Ancestries", "European", "African", "Hispanic", "Chinese")
count_data$population <- factor(count_data$population, levels = pop_order)

#add population sizes
pop_sizes <- data.frame(
  population = factor(pop_order, levels = pop_order),
  pop_size   = c(2953, 1270, 675, 642, 366)
)

count_data_cis <- count_data_cis %>%
  left_join(pop_sizes, by = "population")
count_data_trans <- count_data_trans %>%
  left_join(pop_sizes, by = "population")

#spearman correlation
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2), round(p, 4))
}

cor_cis <- cor.test(count_data$pop_size, count_data$count,
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat("Spearman rho:", round(cor_cis$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("P-value:     ", fmt_p(cor_cis$p.value), "\n")

cor_trans <- cor.test(count_data$pop_size, count_data$count,
                    method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat("Spearman rho:", round(cor_trans$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("P-value:     ", fmt_p(cor_trans$p.value), "\n")
```

**By Fine-Mapping Model Testing**
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(FSA)

#load data
data <- fread("~/compare_susie/meta_cis_tensor_vs_susier_vs_sushie_vs_multi_vs_susiex.tsv", header = TRUE)

#fitler to FDR < 0.05 pQTLs
input_all_cis <- fread("~/tensor_susie/all_race/0.05cis_locations.tsv")
all_data <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(phenotype_id %in% input_all_cis$phenotype_id)

#reshape to long format
make_long <- function(data) {
  rbindlist(list(
    data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(tensor_CS), !is.na(tensor_PIP)) %>%
      group_by(phenotype_id, SNP) %>%
      summarise(CS = max(tensor_CS), PIP = max(tensor_PIP), .groups = "drop") %>%
      distinct(phenotype_id, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(Model = "TensorQTL"),
    
    data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(sushie_CS), !is.na(sushie_PIP)) %>%
      group_by(phenotype_id, SNP) %>%
      summarise(CS = max(sushie_CS), PIP = max(sushie_PIP), .groups = "drop") %>%
      distinct(phenotype_id, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(Model = "SuShiE"),
    
    data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(multi_CS), !is.na(multi_PIP)) %>%
      group_by(phenotype_id, SNP) %>%
      summarise(CS = max(multi_CS), PIP = max(multi_PIP), .groups = "drop") %>%
      distinct(phenotype_id, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(Model = "MultiSuSiE"),
    
    data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(susieX_CS), !is.na(susieX_PIP)) %>%
      group_by(phenotype_id, SNP) %>%
      summarise(CS = max(susieX_CS), PIP = max(susieX_PIP), .groups = "drop") %>%
      distinct(phenotype_id, SNP, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(Model = "SuSiEx")
  ), fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
}

long_data <- make_long(all_data)

Model_order <- c("TensorQTL", "SuShiE", "MultiSuSiE", "SuSiEx")
long_data$Model <- factor(long_data$Model, levels = Model_order)

#per-CS summary (for CS size stats only)
cs_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(Model, phenotype_id, CS) %>%
  summarise(
    cs_size = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#per-protein max PIP (for all PIP stats)
max_pip_protein <- long_data %>%
  group_by(Model, phenotype_id) %>%
  summarise(
    max_pip = max(PIP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
max_pip_protein$Model <- factor(max_pip_protein$Model, levels = Model_order)

#format p-value
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2), round(p, 4))
}

#statistics
desc_cs <- cs_data %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    N_credible_sets  = n(),
    Mean_CS_size     = round(mean(cs_size),   2),
    Median_CS_size   = round(median(cs_size), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

desc_pip <- max_pip_protein %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_max_PIP   = round(mean(max_pip),   3),
    Median_max_PIP = round(median(max_pip), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

high_pip <- long_data %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    N_PIP_gte_0.9    = sum(PIP >= 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prop_PIP_gte_0.9 = round(mean(PIP >= 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

desc_full <- desc_cs %>%
  left_join(desc_pip, by = "Model") %>%
  left_join(high_pip, by = "Model")

print(as.data.frame(desc_full), row.names = FALSE)

#Kruskal-Wallis test
kw_cs  <- kruskal.test(cs_size ~ Model, data = cs_data)
kw_pip <- kruskal.test(max_pip ~ Model, data = max_pip_protein)

pip09_table <- long_data %>%
  mutate(high = PIP >= 0.9) %>%
  group_by(Model, high) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = high, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Model) %>%
  as.matrix()
rownames(pip09_table) <- levels(long_data$Model)
chisq_09 <- chisq.test(pip09_table)

overall_tests <- data.frame(
  Outcome     = c("Credible Set Size", "Max PIP per Protein", "Proportion PIP >= 0.9"),
  Test        = c("Kruskal-Wallis", "Kruskal-Wallis", "Chi-square"),
  Statistic   = round(c(kw_cs$statistic, kw_pip$statistic, chisq_09$statistic), 3),
  df          = c(kw_cs$parameter, kw_pip$parameter, chisq_09$parameter),
  P_value     = fmt_p(c(kw_cs$p.value, kw_pip$p.value, chisq_09$p.value)),
  Significant = c(kw_cs$p.value < 0.05, kw_pip$p.value < 0.05, chisq_09$p.value < 0.05)
)

print(overall_tests, row.names = FALSE)

#post-hoc dunns test
dunn_cs  <- dunnTest(cs_size ~ Model, data = cs_data,         method = "bonferroni")$res
dunn_pip <- dunnTest(max_pip ~ Model, data = max_pip_protein,  method = "bonferroni")$res

format_dunn <- function(d, outcome_label) {
  d %>%
    transmute(
      Outcome     = outcome_label,
      Comparison  = Comparison,
      Z           = round(Z, 3),
      P_unadj     = fmt_p(P.unadj),
      Significant = P.unadj < 0.05
    )
}

pairwise_cs  <- format_dunn(dunn_cs,  "Credible Set Size")
pairwise_pip <- format_dunn(dunn_pip, "Max PIP per Protein")
pairwise_all <- rbind(pairwise_cs, pairwise_pip)

print(as.data.frame(pairwise_all), row.names = FALSE)
```

**Max PIP/Protein Correlations**
```{r}
#load data
data <- read.table("~/compare_susie/meta_cis_tensor_vs_susier_vs_sushie_vs_multi_vs_susiex.tsv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t")

#filter to FDR < 0.05 pQTLs
input_oids <- fread("~/tensor_susie/all_race/0.05cis_locations.tsv") %>%
  select(phenotype_id)

#calculate max PIP per protein for each method
max_pip_data <- data %>%
  group_by(phenotype_id) %>%
  summarise(
    tensor_max = suppressWarnings(max(tensor_PIP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    susieR_max = suppressWarnings(max(susieR_PIP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sushie_max = suppressWarnings(max(sushie_PIP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    multi_max = suppressWarnings(max(multi_PIP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    susieX_max = suppressWarnings(max(susieX_PIP, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tensor_max = ifelse(is.infinite(tensor_max), NA, tensor_max),
    susieR_max = ifelse(is.infinite(susieR_max), NA, susieR_max),
    sushie_max = ifelse(is.infinite(sushie_max), NA, sushie_max),
    multi_max = ifelse(is.infinite(multi_max), NA, multi_max),
    susieX_max = ifelse(is.infinite(susieX_max), NA, susieX_max)
  )

#calculate correlation matrix
methods <- c("tensor_max", "susieR_max", "sushie_max", "multi_max", "susieX_max")
method_names <- c("TensorQTL", "SusieR", "SuShiE", "Multi-SuSiE", "SuSiEx")

#build matricies
max_pip_clean <- na.omit(max_pip_data[, methods, with = FALSE])

correlation_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(methods), ncol = length(methods))
rownames(correlation_matrix) <- method_names
colnames(correlation_matrix) <- method_names

pvalue_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(methods), ncol = length(methods))
rownames(pvalue_matrix) <- method_names
colnames(pvalue_matrix) <- method_names

for (i in 1:length(methods)) {
  for (j in 1:length(methods)) {
    pair_data <- max_pip_data[, c(methods[i], methods[j])]
    pair_clean <- na.omit(pair_data)
    test <- cor.test(
      pair_clean[[methods[i]]],
      pair_clean[[methods[j]]],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    correlation_matrix[i, j] <- test$estimate
    pvalue_matrix[i, j] <- test$p.value
  }
}

print(round(correlation_matrix, 3))
print(format(pvalue_matrix, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3))
```
